unindexed_legacy_outputs_policy: Unindexed artifacts from older runs are not current deliverables; use resbin-index.json only. Source-collision legacy unsuffixed files are preserved, not deleted.
limits: Static success-path model, not execution or complete runtime equivalence proof.
Assumes created nonnull nested objects/arrays, valid managed bounds, AAPCS64 callee preservation and cutVer=1.
Unknown native instructions/calls/data-dependent paths fail closed; only exact sequential overloads and exact nested targets accepted.
Array counts have no wire prefix when count_encoding=none-native-fixed; loop trip counts/strides are recovered from concrete ARM64 instructions.
Big-endian is supported by reader initialization IsNetEndian=1 and native NetworkToHostOrder calls; runtime endian branches and UTF8 virtual method are not formally proved.

Native readString consumes signed int32 length, validates 0<length<=maxStrSize, decodes length-1 bytes and advances length; it does not explicitly check terminal zero. This tool strictly requires terminal zero and valid UTF-8, a conservative subset.
No enum range filtering: enums retain raw numeric values, since unknown/flag values may be valid. Enum wire reader width requires native reader evidence.
FP raw signed int64 is never normalized; exact integer number tokens and decimal-string precision mirrors are emitted. JavaScript consumers must use decimal mirrors or lossless parsing.
CSV nested cells are compact JSON; formula-like/control-leading scalar strings and unsafe spreadsheet integers are apostrophe-prefixed; JSON preserves source values.
Only the 174 baseline arrays/nested/enum rejects are targeted. Baseline missing-schema/layout rejects are left for separate recovery; duplicate namespace variants are distinct source tables.
